parameters.name: EvaluationCount
parameters.description: The number of consecutive health checks.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The health check interval. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: IspCityNode
parameters.description: The list of city nodes for health checks.

sub_parameters.name: CityCode
sub_parameters.description: The city code of the health check node.

sub_parameters.name: IspCode
sub_parameters.description: The carrier code of the health check node.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the response. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

parameters.name: MonitorConfigId
parameters.description: The ID of the health check configuration. You can call the [DescribeDnsGtmInstanceAddressPool](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstanceaddresspool) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: MonitorExtendInfo
parameters.description:
The extended information. The required parameters vary based on the health check protocol.

- HTTP(S):

  - port: The port for the health check.

  - host: The Host header.

  - path: The URL path.

  - code: The health check is considered abnormal if the returned status code is greater than the specified value. For example, if you set this parameter to 400, a returned status code of 404 is considered abnormal.

  - failureRate: The failure rate.

  - sni: Specifies whether to enable Server Name Indication (SNI). This parameter is available only for the HTTPS protocol.

    - true: Enable SNI.

    - false: Disable SNI.

  - nodeType: The type of the node for health checks when the address pool type is DOMAIN.

    - IPV4

    - IPV6

- PING:

  - failureRate: The failure rate.

  - packetNum: The number of ping packets.

  - packetLossRate: The packet loss rate.

  - nodeType: The type of the node for health checks when the address pool type is DOMAIN.

    - IPV4

    - IPV6

- TCP:

  - port: The port for the health check.

  - failureRate: The failure rate.

  - nodeType: The type of the node for health checks when the address pool type is DOMAIN.

    - IPV4

    - IPV6

parameters.name: ProtocolType
parameters.description:
The health check protocol. Valid values:

- HTTP

- HTTPS

- PING

- TCP

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: The timeout period for a health check. Unit: milliseconds.
